mainGoal: Transform kodigital-homepages-cms from single-site CMS into a multi-site CMS where Part-18 of the context doc passes locally (typecheck + tests + verify:no-legacy-prod-refs + verify:infra + verify:worker-config all exit 0), migrations apply against local D1, admin UI exposes Domains tab + New Site modal + per-site filters, admin API serves 11 sites/domains/verticals endpoints, and the 15-step provisioning runner executes individually and idempotently in dry-run mode with zero real Cloudflare API calls.

stories.title: Add Phase 3 multi-site core tables migration
acceptanceCriteria: Migration declares all 9 new tables

BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN fresh local D1, WHEN `npx wrangler d1 migrations apply kodigital-homepages-cms-db --local` runs, THEN sqlite_master contains tables sites, domains, verticals, category_verticals, site_categories, legal_templates, site_creation_jobs, site_creation_job_steps, ai_generations, cache_purge_log.

stories.title: Add Phase 3 indexes for multi-site queries
acceptanceCriteria: All required composite indexes declared
BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN migrations applied locally, WHEN querying sqlite_master for index names, THEN all 13 idx_* names exist.

stories.title: Add site_id and homepage fields to articles
acceptanceCriteria: articles ALTER adds new columns including homepage_section default 'none'

BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN migration applied, WHEN PRAGMA table_info(articles) is queried, THEN columns site_id (NOT NULL after backfill), homepage_section (DEFAULT 'none'), homepage_rank, seo_title, seo_description, ai_generation_id are present.

stories.title: Add site_id/page_type to pages and site_id to media/tags/redirects
acceptanceCriteria: ALTER statements add site_id to pages/media/tags/redirects and page_type to pages
BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN migration applied, WHEN PRAGMA table_info is queried for pages/media/tags/redirects, THEN each has site_id column; pages also has page_type defaulting to 'generic'.

stories.title: Replace globally-unique slug constraints with per-site uniqueness on articles and pages
acceptanceCriteria: Migration creates per-site unique index for articles.slug and pages.slug

BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN migration applied, WHEN inserting two articles with the same slug but different site_id, THEN both inserts succeed; WHEN inserting two articles with same slug + same site_id, THEN the second fails with UNIQUE constraint.

stories.title: Restructure site_settings to (site_id, key) UNIQUE via CREATE-INSERT-DROP-RENAME
acceptanceCriteria: Migration uses CREATE TABLE new -> INSERT OR IGNORE -> DROP -> RENAME pattern (D1 CHECK-constraint safety rule)

BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN pre-restructure site_settings has rows with PK key (e.g. ('siteName','TheIWise')), WHEN migration 0003 runs locally, THEN every pre-existing key survives with site_id NULL (global default) and the new UNIQUE(site_id, key) constraint is enforced.

stories.title: Add idx_settings_site_key index on restructured site_settings
acceptanceCriteria: idx_settings_site_key index created on (site_id, key)
BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN migrations 0002+0003 applied locally, WHEN querying sqlite_master for idx_settings_site_key, THEN one row returned and tbl_name=site_settings.

stories.title: Seed 8 verticals + multi-vertical categories + 4 legal templates
acceptanceCriteria: Seed inserts all 8 vertical slugs
Seed inserts the 4 legal templates

BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN migration 0004 applied locally, WHEN SELECT slug FROM verticals is run, THEN exactly the 8 slugs home,finance,travel,health,parenting,food,tech,lifestyle are returned; WHEN SELECT slug FROM legal_templates is run, THEN privacy-policy, terms, do-not-sell, contact are returned.

stories.title: Seed multi-vertical categories with category_verticals matrix
acceptanceCriteria: Seed inserts >=7 category entries and links them to multiple verticals via category_verticals

BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN seed migration applied, WHEN SELECT category_id, COUNT(vertical_id) FROM category_verticals GROUP BY category_id is run, THEN at least one category has >=2 vertical mappings (e.g. Healthy Meals -> health+food+parenting).

stories.title: Implement site-context module (resolveSiteContextFromRequest, isAdminHost, assertPublicSiteHostNotAdminHost)
acceptanceCriteria: All four required exports + SiteContext type are present

BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN ADMIN_HOST='cms.kodigital.app' in env, WHEN isAdminHost('cms.kodigital.app', env) is called, THEN it returns true; WHEN isAdminHost('mysite.com', env) is called, THEN false; WHEN resolveSiteByHostname(db, 'cms.kodigital.app') is called, THEN it returns null (admin host never resolves as a public site).

stories.title: Implement tenant-guards module (requireSiteIdForArticleInput, assertSlugUniquePerSite, etc.)
acceptanceCriteria: All 8 required tenant-guard exports

BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN article input lacking site_id, WHEN requireSiteIdForArticleInput(input) is called, THEN it throws an error with message containing 'site_id'; WHEN assertTenantBoundary('site-A','site-B') is called, THEN it throws TenantBoundaryViolation.

stories.title: Extend db helpers to accept siteId (listArticles, getArticleBySlug, listCategories, getMediaById)
acceptanceCriteria: Each helper accepts a siteId option/argument and binds it into the prepared statement

BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN fake D1 with two articles slug='hello' in sites A and B, WHEN getArticleBySlug(db, 'hello', { siteId: 'A' }) is called, THEN only the article belonging to site A is returned; WHEN siteId is omitted on public path, the function throws or returns null (no cross-site leak).

stories.title: Add admin sites endpoints: GET/POST /sites + GET/PATCH /sites/:id
acceptanceCriteria: Four sites endpoints registered on admin api

BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN dev bypass + valid domain 'mysite.example', WHEN POST /api/admin/sites is called with {domain,vertical_slug:'home',activity:'main'}, THEN response is 201 with {resource:{id, domain, status:'draft'}} AND a site_creation_job row was created AND assertNotProtectedDomain was called (no theiwise.com may pass).

stories.title: Add admin verticals and domains endpoints: GET /verticals, GET /domains, PATCH /domains/:id
acceptanceCriteria: Three additional endpoints

BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN seed migrations applied, WHEN GET /api/admin/verticals is called, THEN response is 200 with {resource:[{slug:'home'},{slug:'finance'},{slug:'travel'},{slug:'health'},{slug:'parenting'},{slug:'food'},{slug:'tech'},{slug:'lifestyle'}]} (8 items).

stories.title: Add Domains nav item to admin shell (9th explicit admin.get literal)
acceptanceCriteria: Router has 9 literal admin.get('/admin... lines (preserves T10.AC1 contract)
'/admin/domains' route present and uses renderShell

BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN authenticated admin user, WHEN GET cms.kodigital.app/admin/domains is requested, THEN response is 200 HTML containing <meta data-area="domains"> and a 'New Site' button trigger; nav links contain 'Domains'.

stories.title: Build Domains admin page (list + columns + actions + New Site modal)
acceptanceCriteria: Domains view contains all 9 required columns and 6 actions

BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN admin user on /admin/domains, WHEN the New Site button is clicked, THEN a modal appears with three form fields (Domain text input, Vertical select, Activity select defaulted to 'main') and a 'Create site' submit button; all inputs have <label> or aria-label; the modal supports keyboard ESC to close.

stories.title: Build site-provisioning runner with 15 step keys
acceptanceCriteria: All 15 step keys present in steps registry

BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN a pending site_creation_job with status='pending', WHEN POST /api/admin/sites/:id/provision/next is called 15 times in sequence, THEN each call advances exactly one step, persists per-step input/output/status to site_creation_job_steps with attempt_count incremented, returns 200 with {current_step, status} envelope, and the 15th response returns status='completed'.

stories.title: Enforce dry-run safety in provisioning route mutation paths
acceptanceCriteria: Both env helpers consulted before any CF call + uses CLOUDFLARE_PROVISIONING_API_TOKEN exclusively (no CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN)
No reference to CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN anywhere in site-provisioning

BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN SITE_PROVISIONING_DRY_RUN='true' (default), WHEN attach_domain_to_new_worker_or_mark_pending step runs, THEN no fetch() is issued to api.cloudflare.com (intercept proves zero outbound) AND the step persists status='completed_dry_run' AND a cache_purge_log row records the dry-run attempt with both env flag values.

stories.title: Implement create_site_settings step seeding all 12 required keys per site
acceptanceCriteria: All 12 setting keys named

BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN a freshly-created site, WHEN the create_site_settings step completes, THEN SELECT COUNT(*) FROM site_settings WHERE site_id=? returns 12, and tagline + site_description contain deterministic stub values referencing the site name (no AI/OpenAI call was made).

stories.title: Implement legal-template variable substitution in render_generic_legal_pages step
acceptanceCriteria: All 6 template variables substituted

BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN a global legal_templates row for 'privacy-policy' containing '{{site_name}}' and '{{domain}}', WHEN render_generic_legal_pages_with_site_variables runs for site {name:'Acme', domain:'acme.example'}, THEN the rendered HTML stored in pages.content_html contains 'Acme' and 'acme.example' and no '{{' substrings.

stories.title: Site-aware Articles tab UX (Site field + filters + columns + editor)
acceptanceCriteria: Filters render in the toolbar markup

BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN no site selected in the article editor, WHEN the user attempts to save, THEN the form blocks submit with an aria-live='polite' status message stating 'Site is required' AND the POST is never sent. WHEN a site IS selected, THEN the category dropdown is filtered to only categories allocated to that site's vertical(s).

stories.title: Site-aware Pages tab UX (Site filter + Page-type filter + Site selector in About editor)
acceptanceCriteria: Filters and page-type select present

BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN an About page editor, WHEN no site_id is selected, THEN saving is blocked with a status message; legal templates (privacy-policy/terms/do-not-sell/contact) MAY save with site_id NULL (global) and the UI surfaces a 'Global template' badge.

stories.title: Site-aware Categories tab UX (verticals multi-select)
acceptanceCriteria: Verticals multi-select with the canonical 8 slugs is rendered

BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN a category editor, WHEN the user selects verticals ['home','tech'] and saves, THEN category_verticals contains both rows (category_id, vertical_id) and the public site of vertical='home' or 'tech' now sees this category in its allocated list.

stories.title: Site-scoped Settings tab UX (required Site selector + per-site keys + settings_version bump)
acceptanceCriteria: Settings view requires site selector

BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN a site exists with settings_version=1, WHEN PATCH /api/admin/settings updates 'tagline' for that site_id, THEN site_settings row (site_id, 'tagline') value is updated AND sites.settings_version is incremented to 2 in the same transaction.

stories.title: Site filters on Media and Tags tabs
acceptanceCriteria: Both views render a Site filter dropdown

BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN media rows with site_id IN {A, B, NULL}, WHEN the Media tab Site filter is set to 'A', THEN only A's media + global (NULL) media are returned by GET /api/admin/media?site_id=A; explicit 'Global only' selection returns only NULL.

stories.title: Public middleware: inject SiteContext + reject when hostname has no site
acceptanceCriteria: Middleware function exported and registered before public routes

BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN hostname='unknown-site.example' with no row in sites/domains, WHEN GET / is requested, THEN response is a safe 404 (no admin info leak, body MUST NOT contain 'cms.kodigital.app'); WHEN hostname='cms.kodigital.app' is requested via the public router, THEN it returns 404 (admin host MUST NOT resolve as public).

stories.title: Site-aware public routes (article/category/page/feed/sitemap/robots/ads queries scoped by site_id)
acceptanceCriteria: Public router calls site context for each handler

BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN sites A and B each with one article slug='hello', WHEN GET / on hostname-A returns the homepage feed, THEN only A's article is listed; WHEN GET /article/hello on hostname-B is requested, THEN only B's article is rendered (and A's is not visible). robots.txt/ads.txt reflect site_settings rows for that site_id.

stories.title: Harden off-ADMIN_HOST /admin 404 with Cache-Control:no-store + X-Robots-Tag:noindex,nofollow
acceptanceCriteria: Both headers set when /admin off-ADMIN_HOST returns 404

BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN hostname='example.com' (not ADMIN_HOST), WHEN curl -i https://example.com/admin is requested, THEN status is 404, headers include 'Cache-Control: no-store' AND 'X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow', AND the response body does NOT contain 'cms.kodigital.app' AND no Location redirect header is set.

stories.title: Add site-context + tenant-boundary + dry-run + legal-template + protected-domain tests
acceptanceCriteria: At least 8 describe/it scopes across the four new test files cover Part-16 cases
BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN the four new test files exist, WHEN `cd api && npm test` is run, THEN exit code is 0 and at least 12 new individual test cases pass.

stories.title: Add admin-domain + new-site flow + off-admin-host integration tests
acceptanceCriteria: Tests assert protected-domain rejection + idempotency_key + 404 headers

BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN POST /api/admin/sites with domain='theiwise.com', WHEN executed, THEN response is 400 with error referencing protected-domain rejection AND no row is inserted into sites/domains/site_creation_jobs.

stories.title: Generate acceptance-tests bundle (one script per behavioral AC) with chmod 0444 immutability
acceptanceCriteria: At least one script per story (>=30 .sh files) and each has >=1 check() call
run_all.sh exits 0 in dev-server-available environments and 2 (NEEDS_RUNTIME) only for behavioral tests requiring `wrangler dev`

stories.title: Update progress.txt + GUARDRAILS.md + prd.json for Phase B Ralph context
acceptanceCriteria: GUARDRAILS.md re-states HARD RED LINE forbidden refs
progress.txt declares Phase 3 milestones

stories.title: Verify all 5 CI commands pass post-implementation
acceptanceCriteria: All 5 verify commands exit 0
package.json contains all 5 npm scripts

stories.title: Implement GET /api/admin/sites/:id/provision (provisioning status endpoint declared in interface_contract)
acceptanceCriteria: grep -cE 'admin(Api)?\.(get)\("/sites/:id/provision"' api/src/admin/api.ts >= 1

BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN a site with one site_creation_jobs row + N site_creation_job_steps rows, WHEN GET /api/admin/sites/:id/provision is called, THEN response is 200 + {resource:{current_step:int, status:string, step_key:string}} sourced from the latest in-progress or last-completed job step.
BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN no site_creation_jobs row exists for the site_id, WHEN GET /api/admin/sites/:id/provision is called, THEN response is 404 + {error:string} (no leak of internal state).

stories.title: Implement POST /api/admin/sites/:id/purge-cache endpoint (declared in interface_contract; Purge cache UI action wired)
acceptanceCriteria: grep -cE 'admin(Api)?\.(post)\("/sites/:id/purge-cache"' api/src/admin/api.ts >= 1

BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN SITE_PROVISIONING_DRY_RUN=true (default in tests), WHEN POST /api/admin/sites/:id/purge-cache is called, THEN no real Cloudflare API call is made AND a cache_purge_log row is inserted with status='completed_dry_run' AND response is 200 + {resource:{purge_id:string, status:'completed_dry_run'}}.
BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN site_id does not exist, WHEN POST /api/admin/sites/:id/purge-cache is called, THEN response is 404 + {error:string}.
grep -c 'cache_purge_log' api/src/admin/api.ts >= 1

stories.title: Fix CTA label in domains view to match design_contract literal 'Add New Site'
acceptanceCriteria: grep -c 'Add New Site' api/src/admin/views/domains.ts >= 1
grep -cE '>New Site<' api/src/admin/views/domains.ts == 0
BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN renderDomainsView() output, WHEN inspected, THEN the above-fold primary CTA button label is exactly 'Add New Site' (byte-for-byte matching design_contract.cta_sequence[0].label).
